Seasonal Effects for the Strands
The capricious nature of the sea sky, crafts the Strands as much as the coral growths that give it its namesake. While life responds to 
the rhythmic rise and fall of the tide with the steady adaption of evolution, the storms that batter the coast add an element of raw chaos 
that not only forces the flora and fauna quickly into new behaviors, but alters which predator will pursue which prey.
On the Strands, there is no escape from the wild weather that can batter the shore. The coral spires and bridges that make up Dawns 
Reach offer little protection from the storms and waves. To the north west, the wind picks up great billowing clouds of blinding sand off 
the Halfmoon Sands and, to the north east, waves pummel the outcrops of stone that shelter the inner sea. While rarely freezing over in 
the coldest of winters, the temperature of the water fluctuates greatly, causing untold creatures to migrate with each changing season.

Rich Waters ±1 to the Range Result on a Fishing 
Expedition Roll.
Clear Skies Calm weather with no effects.
High Tide Waters rise, obscuring many coral bridges 
lengths of beach. Double any Trawlauth and Daellash 
found on the Expedition Hunt and Scavenger Tables.
Low Tide Waters recede, exposing tidal pools, and sea 
cliffs. Double any Cerrophol, Gharril and Illithisk found 
on the Expedition Hunt and Scavenger Tables.
Misty Shores -1 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely 
on sight beyond 30 ft..
Rain -2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight 
beyond 30 ft.. All Fire damage rolls have a –1 damage 
penalty.
Coral Clouds A fine multicolored mist of coral polyps drift 
over the beach obscuring sight. -2 to Wisdom (Perception) 
checks that rely on sight beyond 30 ft..
Soothing Seas At night the corals among the strands 
bloom, gametes saturate the water in a kaleidoscope of 
glowing colors. Creatures fully submerged in the water 
gain 1 HP up to their maximum HP for every 1 minute in 
the water.
Flourishing Seafloor Basket Cotton spreads across the 
seafloor, their soft bundle leaves soaking in the summer 
sun. Any Foraging Expeditions will yield double the 
result for Basket Cotton.

Tumultuous Tides Powerful waves pummel the shores. 
Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, swimming creatures not 
native to the Strands for every 30 ft. of swimming. Failure: 
Pushed 10 ft. back to the shore.
Rip Tides An undersea current pulls violently from the 
shore. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14, swimming creatures 
not native to the Strands biome for every 30 ft. of 
swimming. Failure: Pulled 10 ft. away from the shore.
Feasting Shores Mawgraw rise up along the sea cliffs, 
capturing untold creatures. This Natural-Trap will be 
encountered more frequently.
Drought Tide The tide significantly lowers, revealing 
more shore to explore. Double any Foraging Expedition 
Results.
Green Death Algae grows out of control and oxygen 
levels drop significantly in the water. Halve any Resource 
Expedition Results, rounding down. Constitution Saving 
Throw: DC 12, for every hour that water breathing 
creatures spend underwater. Failure: They suffer 1 level of 
exhaustion.

Sea Storm -3 to Perception (Wisdom) checks that rely on 
sight or hearing beyond 30 ft.. All Fire damage rolls have a 
–2 damage penalty. Negate the benefits of a Long Rest for 
a Traveler if they have no adequate cover from the rain.
Rising Towers The tendril crowned torrum crawl out 
of the surf in great numbers during this season. This 
Natural-Trap will be encountered more frequently.
Light in the Dark Like the stars above, the cold deep 
sea glows with countless orbs of light. Illuminating the 
darkness and the hidden prey. Any Foraging Expeditions 
will yield double the result for Deep Dawn Orbs.

Floating Havens Hydrozen colonies ride the waves, 
inviting the last of the seasons harvest if one can get 
passed the paralyzed tendrils. This Colony-Trap will be 
encountered more frequently.
Ice Locked Ice floes spread across the coast in thick 
sheets. 5 by 5 ft. squares of ice can be broken with a DC 
12 Strength check.
Cold Water Harvest Eloom, their long glowing tentacles 
blossoming with harvests end, rise from the sea floor. 
Any Foraging Expeditions will yield double the result for 
Eloom Tentacles.

Seasonal Animal Behavior
Shimmering Flight
Tiama glide in great shoals 
during this mating season. 
Double any found on the 
Expedition Hunt and Scavenger 
Tables and they gain Advantage 
to Initiative rolls.
Sun Roasting Rot 
The rank smell of rot wafts in 
the hot wind from beached 
creatures. Double any 
Scavengers Table results.
Rising Hunger
Shaking off the lethargy 
of winter, the goliarch are 
ravenous. Once per day, they 
gain Advantage on their first 
round of attack rolls.
Rising Hunger
Daellash fearlessly protect their 
egg-laden den tunnels. During 
this season, daellash have +1 AC.

Cooler Waters
Daugon swim further out to 
find colder seas and are less 
likely to be seen. Re-roll the first 
of any Hunting Expeditions that 
result in a daugon.
Trawlauth Bacterial Blooms
As the seasons wane, trawlauth 
feast on dying vegetation and 
creatures have Disadvantage 
on Constitution Saving Throws 
against their Bacterial Fume 
ability.
Icebreakers
The spinning vortautilus thrive 
in the frigid waters. Double 
any vortautilus Scavenger 
Tables results, and they gain an 
additional 10 ft. to their swim 
speed.
Blood in the Water
Slannethiss hunt ferociously 
during the harvest moon. They 
gain Advantage in melee attack 
rolls against Bloodied creatures.
They can use the Collapsing 
Coast Lair Action during this 
season.
Shoal Migration 
Spiera migrate out to the deeper 
ocean for prey. Re-roll the first 
of any Hunting Expeditions or 
Scavenger Tables that result in 
a spiera.
Hidden in the Sand
The cold forces gharril into 
a slow torpor state and they 
spend most of their time dug 
into the sand. Re-roll the first 
of any Hunting Expeditions 
or Scavenger that result in a 
gharril and they gain Advantage 
on Stealth Saving Throws.
Keeping Warm
Aggressively staving off the cold 
to protect its urchin growth, the 
illithisk fights furiously. During 
this season, illithisk gain the 
ability; Multiattack The iIllithisk 
makes two attacks, using 
Scything Claw or Paralytic Bite 
in any combination.
Seasonal Weather Effects
Glassy Growths Glass brier clams congregate along the 
shores, their clear adhesive tendrils catching all manner 
of creatures. This Natural-Trap will be encountered more 
frequently.
Barren Corals The colder climate bleaches miles of coral. 
Halve any Foraging Expedition Results, rounding down. 
Rising Hunger
Readying for the flocks of 
seabirds, arkiopti are found 
to be more voracious during 
the summer. They can perform 
4 attack Actions for their 
multiattack instead of 3.
Swimming Into Storm
When the tide comes in, the 
terrestrial coral raises the 
soft fibrous polyp tufts out 
from their protective weave 
so that the incoming surf pulls 
at gameats, sending them out 
to sea to grow elsewhere along 
the coast
Migrating up from the colder depths 
only at height of summer, the squid 
is a rare sight. Its hardened mantle 
working as a kind of sounding bell, 
knocking itself against stone and coral 
to signal far away shoals
Pressures from sexual selection forces 
the crab to grow tall with an impressive 
pronged horn extension of their carapace. 
As males battle each other, they use their 
horns to throw the defeated off from the 
Bastion cliff edges. While not as tall, 
females sport the prong as well so that 
predators do not prey on only the egg 
carrying sex
